# 300.00 USD of travel charged to a US dollar card at 1.35, and the card's
# whole balance transferred to a second US dollar card at 1.40.
#
# The charge opens a cost basis on the owed side at 1.35. The balance transfer
# moves what is owed from one card to the other: the first card owes 300.00
# less and the second 300.00 more, so the owed side owes what it owed before.
# It is a transfer within the owed side, and draws down no cost basis and
# opens none — the card's owed cost basis at 1.35 stands for the 300.00 now
# owed on the second card.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-01-20 * "Travel charged to the card"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Travel 405.00 CAD
	Liabilities:USD Card -300.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-405.00"

2034-02-01 * "Balance transfer of 300.00 USD from the card to card 2"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:USD Card 300.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "420.00"
	Liabilities:USD Card 2 -300.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-420.00"
